newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX crude ends off, tight supply supports Feb.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX crude ends off, tight supply supports Feb.

text.p: NYMEX crude ended lower Friday but short covering amid tight supply made losses only modest in the prompt month, and steepened February's backwardation to March when a raft imports are expected to arrive.

"There is a lot of crude expected to come from the North Sea, so you have this torque effect, where March is being sold and shorts are covering February, widening the spread," said Michael Busby, trader with Northville Industries in Melville, N.Y. February crude settled off 11 cents at $25.41 a barrel.
The Feb/March backwardation had expanded to more than $1.00 through most of the session. It was 70 cents Thursday.
